• Meaning of "Some A are B" in Syllogism - there is at least one point in A which is in B.
 
• Meaning of "All A are B" in Syllogism - each point of A is in B.
 
• This explains why "some" can be considered as a subset of "all".
 
• Therefore, *if "All A are B" is true, then "some A are B" is always true.*

***The least possible Venn diagram is:***__

I. Some snakes are toads. → True (as "all toads are frogs and all frogs are snakes" so some snakes are toads it is definite, hence, true)

II. Some frogs are toads. → True (as all toads are frongs given so some frogs are toads it is definite, hence, true)

Hence,** "Both conclusions follow" **is the correct answer.

questions.question: A loan becomes a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) when the interest or principal becomes overdue for a period of:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**90 days**__.

__
 
• Most of the time, **debt** is classified **as nonperforming when loan payments have not been made for a period of 90 days (Standard period).**
 
• A nonperforming asset is** a debt obligation where the borrower has not made any previously agreed-upon interest and principal repayments to the designated lender for an extended period of time.**
 
• **A loan can be classified as a nonperforming asset at any point during the term of the loan or at its maturity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Type of non-performing asset:
 
 
• The most common nonperforming assets are term **loans**.
 
• **Overdraft and cash credit (OD/CC) accounts were left out-of-order for more than 90 days.**
 
• **Agricultural advances interest or principal instalment payments** **remain overdue for two crop/harvest seasons for short duration crops or overdue one crop season for long duration crops.**
 
 
 
• Banks are recording Non-Performing Assets (NPA) in three categories: **sub-standard assets, doubtful assets, and loss assets.**
 
 
• **A sub-standard** asset is an asset classified as an NPA for** less than 12 months**.
 
• **A doubtful asset** is an asset that has been non-performing for **more than 12 months**.
 
• **Loss assets are loans with losses identified by the bank, auditor, or inspector that need to be fully written off.**

questions.question: When the government’s total revenue, excluding borrowings, is less than the planned expenditure,it is called:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**fiscal deficit**__.

__
 
• **Fiscal deficit = Total expenditure – Total receipts excluding borrowings.**
 
• **It is the amount of borrowing the government has to resort to meet its expenses.**
 
 
• **A large deficit means a large amount of borrowing.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• There are **three different types of deficit** in a budget depending upon the types of receipts and expenditure we take into consideration.

 
 
• **Revenue deficit.**
 
• **Fiscal deficit.**
 
• **Primary deficit.**
 
 
 
• **Revenue deficit = Total revenue expenditure – Total revenue receipts.**
 
 
• **It is an excess of total revenue expenditure of the government over its total revenue receipts.**
 
• In another way, **the shortfall of total revenue receipts compared to total revenue expenditure.**
 
 
 
• **Primary deficit = Fiscal deficit – Interest payments.**
 
 
• It is defined as the **fiscal deficit of current year minus interest payments on previous borrowings.**
 
 
 
• **Deficit financing is the budgetary situation where expenditure is higher than the revenue.**
 
 
• It is a practice adopted for financing the excess expenditure with outside resources.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Budget deficit = total expenditure – total receipts.**
 
• **Monetized Fiscal Deficit = that part of the fiscal deficit covered by borrowing from the RBI.**

• The upward folds are known as anticlines, and the downward folds are synclines.
 
• Example: **Himalayan Mountains in Asia**__, the Alps in Europe, the Andes in South America, the Rockies in North America, the Urals in Russia.
